## Experience

### Movida Aluguel de Carros — Software Engineer (Aug 2023 – present, São Paulo)
Backend for Movida's 24h roadside assistance platform (towing, locksmiths, batteries, tyres) across Brazil. Scale: 300,000+ tracked vehicles, 7,000+ service providers, 50,000+ service requests a month.
- Built and maintains the REST APIs used by internal systems and 7,000+ service providers
- Built a reusable real-time notification microservice with SignalR
- Improves production reliability: incident investigation, root-cause analysis, database tuning
- Delivers features end to end across .NET and Angular 17
- Works on AWS (EC2, RDS, ECR, S3) with Docker and Azure DevOps pipelines
- Stack: .NET Core, C#, SignalR, EF Core, MySQL, Angular 17, AWS, Docker, microservices

### DHAUZ — Software Engineer (Aug 2022 – Aug 2023, remote)
Uorkz, a hiring and talent-matching platform, and a sales-forecasting SaaS for enterprise clients.
- Wrote Infrastructure-as-Code that provisions a full environment for each new SaaS customer
- Built the AWS infrastructure: EC2, RDS, SQS, S3, Route 53, CloudFormation
- Designed multi-tenant database schemas in MySQL
- Built .NET Core services for hiring workflows, matching logic and forecasting
- Stack: .NET Core, C#, AWS, CloudFormation, SQS, MySQL, Angular, Docker

### MODALGR — Software Engineer (Sep 2021 – Aug 2022, Santos, SP)
Hexagon Pro, a web system for ports and terminals that traces bulk cargo exports.
- Built backend features and APIs for cargo and terminal workflows
- Wrote data access with Dapper and optimised Oracle queries over large datasets
- Applied DDD and SOLID to keep the codebase clean and testable
- Stack: C#, .NET Core, Dapper, Oracle, DDD, SOLID

### ed (client: CAIXA) — Software Engineer (May 2021 – Sep 2021, Rio de Janeiro)
XCAP do Bem, CAIXA's online platform for selling capitalisation bonds.
- Built backend APIs and business logic in .NET Core and EF Core
- Wrote unit tests first (TDD) with xUnit
- Designed MySQL structures for transactional flows; CI/CD on Azure DevOps
- Stack: C#, .NET Core, EF Core, MySQL, xUnit, TDD

### Log Planning (client: Ipiranga) — Integration Developer (Dec 2018 – May 2021, Rio de Janeiro)
System integrations for Ipiranga, one of Brazil's largest fuel distributors, on InterSystems Ensemble. Started as an intern, became a developer in Mar 2020.
- Rewrote and adjusted 100+ integrations affected by an ERP upgrade
- Built SOAP and REST integrations using a service-oriented (SOA) architecture
- Set up new integrations in the Kong API gateway
- Stack: InterSystems Ensemble, SOAP, REST, SOA, Kong

## Side projects

- [GeekShopping](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/GeekShopping): e-commerce platform split into .NET 8 microservices (products, cart, coupons, orders, payments, email) behind an Ocelot API gateway, with IdentityServer auth, RabbitMQ messaging and Docker Compose
- [DevFreela](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/DevFreela): freelancer marketplace API on .NET 8 with CQRS, MediatR, JWT roles, EF Core and xUnit; finishing a project sends the payment to DevFreela.Payments over RabbitMQ
- [DevFreela.Payments](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/DevFreela.Payments): payment microservice split out of DevFreela; consumes payment requests and publishes payment-approved events over RabbitMQ (.NET 8)
- [MyMovieScore](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/MyMovieScore): movie list and rating API on .NET 6 with OMDb data, clean architecture, CQRS, Docker Compose, Swagger
- [TaskControl](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/TaskControl): task management web app with progress charts and PDF reports (ASP.NET Core MVC, .NET 8, Dapper, SQL Server, Highcharts)
